input.quote: THE LICENSED TECHNOLOGY IS PROVIDED ON AN "AS IS" BASIS WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY KIND AND LICENSOR HEREBY
input.rationale: Article VIX is a pure "AS IS" disclaimer covering merchantability, non-infringement, fitness and title, and expressly denies any assurance that errors or non-conformity to Documentation will be corrected. There is no express performance or conformance warranty and no repair/replace/refund remedy anywhere — only "commercially reasonable efforts" error correction (p0093) — which is the walk-away position. We have inserted a 90-day conformance warranty, a workmanlike-services warranty, a no-malicious-code warranty and the standard remedy, carved out of the disclaimer.

There is no insurance covenant anywhere in the Agreement (the only reference to insurance is as a cost we must bear under p0051), even though Licensor hosts the Platform and Hardware and processes our trade data. We have inserted our standard coverages (CGL 1M/2M, E&O 2M, cyber 5M) with certificates on request; E&O 1M plus cyber 2M is our fallback.

input.quote: The Licensee shall calculate the license fee payable to the Licensor for each month based on the Monthly Notional Volume bands for that pay period and shall pay the Licensor accordingly.
input.rationale: Fees are purely usage-based per US$1m traded, with no minimum volume, take-or-pay or shortfall charge; the p0070 floor is simply a true-up to actual recorded volume. The fixed $2,500/month support fee and the 33% Supplemental Payments revenue share are separate commercial items, not volume commitments, and there are no caps on our usage.
